newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian reinsurer Tunis-Re '96 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian reinsurer Tunis-Re '96 profits up.

text.p: Societe Tunisienne de Reassurance Tunis-Re had 1.99 million dinars net profits in 1996, up from 1.37 million dinars in 1995, results showed on Friday.
It said it will start distributing a statutary five percent dividend and a three percent super dividend on June 27. It distributed the same dividends in 1995.
Tunis-Re, one of the five off-shore reinsurance firms established in Tunisia, is currently in the process of raising its capital to 35 million dinars from 15 million dinars.
The company was launched in 1981 with a capital in which the Tunisian state subscribed a ten percent stake, Tunisian insurance companies 42 percent and Tunisian banks the remaining 48 percent.
